message: No detected input validation: The _read_tsv/_read_txt methods and _create_examples simply read and parse lines without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the fields.

No detected untrusted source handling: The PRETRAINED_MODEL_ARCHIVE_MAP and PRETRAINED_VOCAB_ARCHIVE_MAP point to S3 URLs fetched via cached_path, but no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision/hash is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only defines expected labels as ["0", "1"] in get_labels() but never validates actual label values against this set or performs any distribution comparison or label-noise detection.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples during data preparation; input lines are read and parsed directly without any suspicious-input filtering.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained BERT weights via `BertForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained` and downloads vocab/model files through `cached_path` from S3 URLs without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set against actual labels, or detects anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard BertAdam optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism present.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data at the code level, and only standard metrics (MCC, F1) are used without any integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads raw text from TSV/TXT files and passes it directly to the tokenizer and model without any shape, range, length, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output logits or probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range values, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning predictions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, it is a BERT sequence classifier (not a generative LLM), and no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation is implemented.
